checks: Five native tests: 46,656 six-step histories (279,936 transitions), uncertainty interaction, empty-content slot gate, four polarity preimages, ordered givenness.
cost: For S sentences, T tokens and Q open questions, conservative O(S Q T^2 + S T log(S T)) comparisons plus string/global animacy costs; output reasons can grow with rejected candidates.
description: Preannotated QUD stack selection and accommodation
forward: State=(open stack,given lemmas,last subject). Prepare tokens, push questions or select latest congruent, accommodate if none, then update given/last. One Step per input. No probabilistic ranking.
Preparation feeds slot eligibility, then tracking applies completeness only after ranking. track adds external annotator/splitting. Tests use track_toks only; malformed heads remain trusted.
inverse: Behavior complement: source-derived inner excluded transitions under stated invariant/priority constraints.
Reverse reconstruction: all compatible antecedents under fixed dependencies; projected observations are many-to-one.
limitations: Partial source syntax, no semantic AST or complete proof.
No live parser, teacher, full mining export, GPU or throughput evidence.
state: Ordered supplied tokens, question stack, given lemmas, last subject, fixed animacy snapshot.
